title: Chapter 242 Alchemy And Gu
content:
Chapter 242 Alchemy And Gu

At this time, the old man walked to Lu Daosheng again, kicked Lu Daosheng's stool, and said Qinghe: "And you, get out!"

"While I am in a good mood now, I don't want to kill."

As soon as these words came out, Lu Daosheng, who was sitting, suddenly laughed.

For some reason, he felt that this personality was very suitable for him as an alchemist in Huangcheng.

It's you.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng slowly stood up, looked at the old man in front of him and said, "You should have a high level of alchemy cultivation, right?"

Hearing this, the old man was slightly stunned, and then he laughed fiercely.

"Hehehe, alchemy? I have long since I tried to practice that thing."

"If this is your purpose, then you should get out as soon as possible!"

However, Lu Daosheng's smile became even worse.

"So, are you really strong in elixir?"

Suddenly, the old man frowned. Now he no longer wanted to waste time with the guy in front of him.

"I will say it last, I will give you three breaths and disappear in front of me immediately, otherwise,

"Otherwise what?"

Lu Daosheng groaned.

The next moment, a terrifying aura slowly overflowed from Lu Daosheng's body.

In an instant, everything around changed.

The clouds were covered with dark clouds, the void was shattered, and the surrounding space was constantly collapsing.

The entire village suddenly felt like the end of the world.

At the same time, a chill surged from the old man's body and rushed straight into the sky.

"you!"

The old man's face turned pale and his pupils shrank slightly.

I have wandered around the world, lived for endless years, been an immortal, and became a demon. This is the first time I have encountered such a terrifying person.

Yuanyuan inside the house also noticed the breath outside and immediately walked out with a panic look on his face.

When he saw Lu Daosheng outside the house, Yuanyuan looked frightened.

But at this time, the old man in front of Lu Daosheng turned around and shouted coldly: "Who asked you to come out? Let me roll in and prepare all the medicinal materials!"

"Are you fucking deaf? I'll let you roll in!"

The old man's cold voice rang.

In this way, Yuanyuan walked into the house again.

"How is it, have you changed your mind?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng spoke again.

This time, the old man did not exude fragrance again, but said with a serious expression: "What the hell do you want to do?"

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng restrained his breath, and everything around him suddenly returned to its original state.

I heard Lu Daosheng smile and said, "There is a lack of an alchemist in my power."

"Of course, if you have something else, it's better, after all, you can't help but have more skills."

But when he heard Lu Daosheng's words, the old man sneered: "Do I have the right to refuse?"

"You have."

The old man was slightly stunned and breathed a sigh of relief.

But just as he was about to refuse, Lu Daosheng continued, "But I may not be able to kill all sides because of this."

"This radius of a hundred miles is only you master and disciple."

As he said that, Lu Daosheng looked inside the house meaningfully.

"You disciple, it's a pity to kill you."

Suddenly, the old man in front of Lu Daosheng trembled, his fists clenched, his nails embedded in his palms, and blood slowly overflowed.

He would never have thought that one day he would be threatened by others.

At this time, Yuanyuan was sitting on the ground with her back against the wooden door, tears kept falling, covering her mouth tightly to prevent herself from making any sound.

Seeing that the old man in front of him was still hesitating, Lu Daosheng pretended to sigh, and then slowly walked towards the direction inside the house.

"Wait a moment!"

"oh?"

Lu Daosheng turned his head and looked, "What, have you considered it?"

But in his heart, Lu Daosheng understood.

This old guy really cares about his little apprentice.

At this moment, the old man gritted his teeth and said coldly: "I can be an alchemist for your power, but you cannot limit my freedom. Moreover, you must have all the materials I want within your power, otherwise I will definitely leave. ”

Obviously, after Lu Daosheng's oppression, the old man was forced to agree to Lu Daosheng.

When Lu Daosheng heard the old man's words, he immediately smiled.

"Can."

Let’s start by rotting the old man to the deserted city. When this old man enters the deserted city, he probably won’t think of coming out again.

This is the experience accumulated by Lu Daosheng over the years.

At the same time, Yuanyuan in the house also walked out with red eyes.

"Master."

Yuanyuan's voice trembled.

She was not afraid of Lu Daosheng's pressure just now, but the old man's attitude towards her.

All along, the doubts in her heart finally cleared away the clouds.

What I raise myself is to use her to refine the Gu in the future, and what it is just a pity to kill her now.

They are all lie.

He really cares about himself.

Otherwise, why did he teach himself so much?

Although the old man never asked her to call him Master, she always called him that.

In Yuanyuan's heart, this sloppy old man was not only her master, but also her only relative.

But at this time, the old man shouted and cursed at her again.

"Why are you crying? Do you want to be disgusted?!"

But Yuanyuan did not retreat again this time, but walked forward with the courage to hug the old man gently.

At this moment, the old man was completely stunned.

"Master, thank you."

On the side, Lu Daosheng also looked at the warm scene in front of him in surprise.

This is probably two-way redemption.

After a long time, Yuanyuan let go of the old man.

Looking at the wet gaze of the girl in front of her, the old man quickly turned around.

"If you dare to do this, I will definitely refine you into a Gu next time!"

Upon hearing this, Yuanyuan smiled.

Lu Daosheng also laughed.

......

"My city lord, my name is Shi Liantian. He was once an alchemist."

When Lu Daosheng heard this name, he couldn't help but feel a little surprised.

This name is too domineering.

Lien Tian, it’s so crazy.

"Then why don't you refine alchemy now?"

Lu Daosheng asked.

I thought Shi Liantian would say that the pill was useless, or that it was simply changing careers or something.

But unexpectedly, Shi Liantian said, "It's too simple and not difficult, so now I'm refining the Gu."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng's expression moved slightly.

"If you refining a Gu, it will take a lot of life."

Hearing this, Shi Liantian was stunned, then chuckled, "Master Lord, what you said is wrong."

"There is actually no difference between refining a Gu and refining an alchemy."

"If you have to say it, it is much more complicated to refine Gu, but in fact, the same end is the same."

"Some pills need life to be refined, and similarly, some pots need to be refined, and the same is true for them."

These words undoubtedly surprised Lu Daosheng.

I have never understood the aspect of refining Gu. After saying this, Jingshi Liantian suddenly realized.

"Been taught a lesson."

Then, Lu Daosheng looked at Yuanyuan behind Shi Liantian with a slightly sideways look.

"Is this girl good at refining a Gu?"

Hearing this, Shi Liantian showed a smile with a little pride.

"I know a little, but I have been studying too little, but she is still very good at elixir."
